Player Impressions:
Hoyos - A couple of tremendous saves back to back.  Went on a wayward journey.  If this was FIFA, I'd say he was trying to score
Jacob - a disappointing night.  Had a few bad passes.  his crosses are generally off the mark
Díaz - another poor performance.  not organized on the back line.  easily beaten.  Had a few good clerances
Alonso.- a poor night overall.  Not up to the pace.  seemed resigned to the loss early on
Báez - couldn't cope with the attackers on his side
Muyumba - He should have been the midfield leader tonight.  Most senior, most playing time.  Off the pace and couldn't connect passes
Fortune - lots of rust, like the last time he came back from injury.  He'll be good after a couple of games.  Atlanta doesn't have many games left.
Amaro - a good night overall.  A few bad passes early on.   Improved as the night went on.  Seems more like he's not yet on the same page as those around him
Miranchuk - another disappointing night.  Is simply not affecting play.  He needs others to raise his game.
Almirón - Played deep in the 1st half.  Pushed up higher in the 2nd.  Much better the higher he goes.  Not in-line with Embolo like he was last game
Embolo - a confusing night.  At times, he moved around well.  At others, he was invisible.  And those forward flips to get a call?  I hope that's the last we see of them.

subs:  
Gill - started out strong.  Good movement, good passing, good defense.  By the end, he was invisible
Brennan - He looked godo .  Pushing hard to get up the pitch and make something happen.  He just couldn't.  
Mihaj - Didn't have much time tonight, but he stabilized the backline and made some impressive saves.  
Santos - I cannot see why he's on the pitch.  He has no control on the ball, and can't get in good positions.  He complains a lot.
Picault - a few good crosses on the left.  Wasn't able to penetrate the back line

Tata - He left a struggling Jacob on the pitch and pushed him up.  Should have brought on Mihaj earlier.  He tried improving things early with Gill.  And an attacking player with Brennan.  He changed subs and positions.  None worked out.
Surely he should bring on Togashi instead of Santos.
